title: This annotation should be attached to a library directive.
summary: Try attaching the annotation to a library directive. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 2.19.
message_templates: This annotation should be attached to a library directive.

title: The library directive must appear before all other directives.
summary: Try moving the library directive before any other directives.
message_templates: The library directive must appear before all other directives.

title: The library name '…' isn't a lower_case_with_underscores identifier.
summary: Try changing the name to follow the lower_case_with_underscores style. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.
message_templates: The library name '{}' isn't a lower_case_with_underscores identifier.

title: The prefix '…' isn't a lower_case_with_underscores identifier.
summary: Try changing the prefix to follow the lower_case_with_underscores style. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.
message_templates: The prefix '{}' isn't a lower_case_with_underscores identifier.

title: Invalid use of a private type in a public API.
summary: Try making the private type public, or making the API that uses the private type also be private. Its category is publicInterface. It is stable since Dart 2.14.
message_templates: Invalid use of a private type in a public API.

title: The line length exceeds the 80-character limit.
summary: Try breaking the line across multiple lines. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.
message_templates: The line length exceeds the 80-character limit.

title: The Boolean expression has a constant value.
summary: Try changing the expression. Its category is unusedCode. It is stable since Dart 2.2.
message_templates: The Boolean expression has a constant value.
